presentation.label: INTRODUCTION
presentation.title: DAGESTAN
presentation.p1: A republic of the Russian Caucasus, Dagestan is a land of mountains and traditions. This is where wrestling has been passed from father to son for centuries. The mountain villages have produced more Olympic champions per capita than anywhere else on Earth.
presentation.p2: Makhachkala, the capital, houses dozens of fight gyms where hundreds of international-level athletes train daily. These are the gyms MKR takes you to.

safety.p1: No empty talk. The reality on the ground in 2026: the region where the camp takes place is stable and frequented by athletes from around the world. The training cities (Makhachkala, Kaspiysk) are normal urban areas.
safety.p2: The French Foreign Ministry advises against certain border zones, not the urban areas where we operate. Each participant is briefed in detail before departure.
safety.testimonial_quote: I went alone, without speaking Russian. The welcome is incredible. On the mat, the level is brutal.

presentation.label: INTRODUCTION
presentation.title: CHECHNYA
presentation.p1: A republic of the Russian Caucasus west of Dagestan, Chechnya is the epicenter of modern MMA. In fifteen years, Grozny has become a mandatory stop for world fighters: State structures, private stables, and very high-level sparring.
presentation.p2: Akhmat Fight Club gathers a unique concentration of pro fighters. It is within this ecosystem that MKR opens access for its MMA camps, with French-speaking coaching staff and local partnerships.

safety.p1: No empty talk. The reality on the ground in 2026: Grozny is today one of the safest cities in the Caucasus in terms of urban crime. Visible police, almost no nightlife, strong hospitality toward foreign athletes.
safety.p2: The French Foreign Ministry maintains regional caution. MKR operates only in the urban areas and accredited partner gyms. Each participant gets a detailed briefing.
safety.testimonial_quote: Respect for fighters is total. On the mat, they don't give you anything for free.
